summary: The cut opens on a bright white frame (4.50), then two inverted high-contrast threshold frames (4.54, 4.58), before the real shot appears at 4.62 and stays steady; this looks like a deliberate flash, but the inverted frames are rough.

faults.what: Two frames (4.54, 4.58) show a harsh black/white inverted threshold look of the scene before the real shot appears at 4.62. The flash reads as a glitch and not as a designed transition, and the white frame at 4.50 makes it a three-frame stutter.
faults.fix: Cut straight to the 4.62 frame, or make the flash a single clean white frame that fades into the shot.
